---
title: index.md
description: Index template
---

`index.md` is a special template that is always applied to prompts.

## Example

Given the following index.md file:

```index.md
Please,

{{.Prompt}}

Thank you!
```

And the following prompt

```
prompter "Do the thing!"
```

Output:

```
Please,

Do the thing!

Thank you!
```
